release_name: Live TV v3.9.4 — Zero-Scroll Mobile Player & Advanced Feature Suite
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 Zero-Scroll Viewport Layout: Removed the Mac sticky bar from the Phone TV tab so the mobile video player starts immediately at the top without being obstructed or needing any scrolling to view
🎬 Mobile Quality & Bitrate Switcher: Instant manual and adaptive resolution selector (Auto, 1080p Full HD, 720p HD, 480p, 360p)
⛶ Display Zoom & Aspect Ratio: 1-tap toggle between Fit (16:9 Letterbox), Fill Screen (Zoomed edge-to-edge with no black bars), and Stretch
⏮⏭ Mobile Channel Surfer: Dedicated Prev/Next channel buttons on the mobile player to flip through live channels directly on your phone
⏱️ Mobile Sleep Timer: Bedtime countdown timer (15m, 30m, 45m, 60m, 90m) that automatically pauses playback to conserve battery and mobile data
🌙 Bedtime Brightness Dimmer: Dim video screen down to 40% for comfortable late-night viewing in dark rooms
🔒 Screen Lock & Live DVR: 1-tap accidental touch screen lock, 10s Rewind/Forward, and Go Live button
🔍 In-Player Channel Search: Search and tune any of the 2,989 channels directly within the Phone TV tab without switching screens
